scope: Current R136 monitor coverage versus exact C; no candidate adoption or deployment

policy.scope: R143 current R136 versus exact C router monitor coverage; no candidate adoption decision
policy.candidate_means: Existing generic R136 ce3d1aa29e49a8ea51bb7afa2587846ccd7563aa4b7c983cf401a6b4d6de2330, never rejected R142

performance.order: c,candidate on even zero-based windows; candidate,c on odd windows
performance.ratio: same-window R136/C, computed separately for every metric
performance.test: For each metric and each direction, count the ten ratios strictly beyond its threshold. One-sided exact binomial sign p = sum(comb(10,j), j=k..10)/2^10. Threshold ties and every other window remain nonsupporting trials; none are removed.
performance.family: All six prespecified tests: mean/p95/p99 times lower/higher, including both directions irrespective of observed data
performance.adjustment: Holm step-down, exact rational arithmetic, family-wise alpha 0.05; adjusted p <= alpha confirms the corresponding direction beyond its 1% threshold
performance.unresolved: All other results are unresolved, never equivalence or noninferiority. Inclusive median plus/minus 1% is an unresolved magnitude band. A median outside it without adjusted significance remains unresolved.
performance.unit: Ten paired windows, not the 100000 operation samples. Conditional inference assumes independent window signs; Holm handles dependence across metric/direction tests, not serial dependence of windows.
performance.stopping: Exactly ten complete windows. Preserve all cases, raw vectors, negative findings and failures; no selected windows, threshold changes, added windows or retries to rescue a direction.
performance.cpu: CPU and outer wall are descriptive, outside the latency family; no wall-minus-CPU mechanism inference

memory.interpretation: Descriptive absolute KiB, per-process growth from same-delay empty baseline, same-window R136-minus-C differences, all three values and ranges. No significance, peak/heap/PSS inference, equivalence or resource acceptance without a separate budget. Memory samples never enter performance tests.

limitations: Only current R136 versus C coverage; no rejected R142 candidate, adoption or deployment.
Paired windows are the statistical units; exact sign inference assumes independent window signs. Holm does not repair serial dependence.
Caller poll/validation and timer overhead remain included; no per-operation migration or scheduler trace and no wall-minus-CPU inference.
Memory snapshots are separate descriptive residency observations, not peak allocation, heap, PSS, equivalence or resource acceptance.
Every frozen window and negative observation remains; this coverage does not cancel earlier registration-tail findings.
